name: Juan Santamaría International Airport

runway.v: one runway 07/25, 3,011 m x 45 m asphalt

hours.v: airport, ATS, fuel and handling H24

noise.v: noise procedure for RWY 07 departures: keep runway heading at the best rate of climb to 4 DME and 5,500 ft, then turn right towards TIO VOR
noise.quote: Mantener rumbo de Pista con el régimen máximo de ascenso posible, hasta 4 DME y 5500 pies

notes: Read: Costa Rica AIP Part 3 AD (DGAC), file 'PARTE-3-AD-AIRAC-28-19MAY22' (AIRAC AMDT 28, 19 MAY 2022; MROC AD 2.3 page dated 12 JUN 17, AD 2.12 area AMDT 26/27). This is the latest AIP edition found free on sub.dgac.go.cr; the AIP is otherwise sold by subscription, so a newer AMDT may exist. Known 2026 supplements not read: SUP 27/26 'MROC AD 2.20 Reglamentos de Tránsito Locales' (item 11) and SUP 28/26 'MROC AD 2.8' (https://sub.dgac.go.cr/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/sa27_26-MROC-2.20-ITEM-11.pdf, not opened). Marked partial because the AD 2.20 text read is older than these supplements. No curfew, slot or PPR rule seen in the 2022 text; aircraft over 25,000 lb may not make 180-degree turns on the runway unless ATS allows; parking only with marshaller. Spanish source; English is a translation.
